meta.summary: Independent Godot RPG. Only Kanban UI/validator reused from Packet Defense. Installation, runtime, simulation and local AI studio are future implementation tasks.

howToUse.forAI: Read AGENTS.md and START_HERE.md. Execute one dependency-ready ticket. Install missing tools by phase. Record actual evidence before marking done.
howToUse.forHumans: Serve this project with node tools/serve.js and open /backlog/. Board reads only; edit JSON to update.
howToUse.editing: node tools/verify.js after edits. Never mark a specification as an implemented capability.

status.done: Implemented, verified with evidence and committed.
status.later: Planned; prerequisites or phase gate not yet met.

size.L: Substantial; split if it cannot be verified in one session.

meta.scoreNote: value * 2 - risk * 1.5 + priorityBonus (9,5,2,0). Dependencies and phase gates take precedence.
